The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a workbench introduced with the [[Better Save Soul|Better Save Soul DLC]], that may be built in the [[Souls room]] after the [[Soul healer]] is repaired. The {{PAGENAME}} allows you to convert [[Healed soul]]s to Souls' gratitude ({{Souls Room Capacity}}) points.<br>
The number of points generated from this is based on the soul condition. These points ({{Techpoint|soul}}) can be used to remote craft or to unlock new technologies.
